info.name: LNG Web BE - Auth RBAC
info.description:
Auth RBAC collection for local POD FBM backend testing.

Recommended local setup:
1. Run npm run seed:auth:demo-users, or at least npm run seed:auth.
2. Run npm run dev.
3. Run folder "00 Happy Flow - Seeded Demo" from top to bottom.

Auth source of truth: AccessAssignment. ScopedRolePermission is the canonical scoped override model.
